reviews.title: Inconsistent moderation, mindless support
reviews.text:
I've had a rocky experience with Linktree that raises some real concerns about how the platform is managed.

Red flag 1: About a year ago, I received two separate emails, roughly an hour apart, both informing me that my account had been unbanned. I hadn't been notified of any ban in the first place, so this was strange, though I let it slide at the time.

Red flag 2: More recently, I discovered that Signal URLs work perfectly fine in the top "Quick Links" bar, but are blocked in the main body of my Linktree page for being a "suspicious link." Signal is a well-established, widely trusted messaging app, so this inconsistency doesn't make sense. If the link is safe enough for one part of the page, why is it flagged as suspicious in another? This smells like a programming or policy oversight that nobody has bothered to fix.

Red flag 3: When I reached out to support for clarification, I was simply told that I can't post "suspicious links," without any acknowledgment of the double standard I'd pointed out. No real explanation, no fix, just a canned response.

Linktree, do better. This seems like amateur hour.

There are tons, just tons of these social link organizing apps. Other options offer better user experience, improved support, less cluttered ads in the page and forwarding emails.

When using this app I’ve noticed even with me updating my app on my phone. I’m unable now to use this app with my screen reader, when I login to this app when before I was able to access all of its features, and now I’m unable to access any of its features with my screen reader software. It won’t read anything to me on the screen and now when I tap on the screen and try to navigate with VoiceOver gestures my screen won’t even read what’s on the screen. I am making a note of this because I think it’s important for the developers of this app to know that this app needs to be adjusted so it’s accessible for not just decided community but for the blind community. Hope all you have a wonderful day.

reviews.title: Bad customer support
reviews.text:
I’ve had a serious unresolved technical issue with my account for several months. Stripe-related features never worked properly: I couldn’t upload eligible affiliate links, sell digital products, or even access the Earnings section — everything showed “Something went wrong.”

I contacted support multiple times over many months while continuing to pay the monthly membership. Each time, I was asked to try a new device or browser (which I had already done repeatedly: phone, iPad, laptop, multiple browsers). The issue was never escalated or actually investigated.

I also spoke directly with Stripe, and from their side everything was working correctly. This strongly suggests a platform-side integration issue that was never resolved.

The lack of real technical support, combined with ongoing billing for a non-functional service, made this experience frustrating and time-consuming. I eventually canceled my membership and moved to another platform.

reviews.title: No integration with Shopify

They have you jumping through hoops, disabling firewalls etc, when they already know it is not working and they are supposedly ‘working’ on it with their engineering team’. They have no idea when it will be ready and advised me to check back in 1 month!  Don’t waste your money upgrading your membership.
